info.title: Ignixa.SchemaUpgrade.Cli
info.description: Operator-triggered CLI for reviewing and applying tenant database schema upgrades that SchemaDeployer's automatic path refused to apply.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Reviews and applies a pending schema upgrade for a tenant database that SchemaDeployer's automatic path refused.

options.name: --confirm
options.description: Apply the upgrade without an interactive prompt (for scripted/CI use). [default: False]

options.name: --allow-data-loss
options.description: Permit the deploy to proceed even when SqlPackage/DacFx would otherwise block it as possibly data-lossy. Required to apply diffs flagged unsafe by DeployReportClassifier. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-incompatible-platform
options.description: Permit the deploy to proceed when the target server's platform differs from the dacpac's target platform. The schema targets Azure SQL Database, so this is required when deploying to a box SQL Server (local development, on-premises, or a test container). [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Path to a JSON configuration file with tenant connection settings. Defaults to appsettings.json in the current working directory. [default: appsettings.json]
